transform_embedding_request: transform an OpenAI-style embedding request into IBM WatsonX API format
get_complete_url: build the complete WatsonX embeddings URL from api base, model, and optional params
transform_embedding_response: convert a WatsonX embeddings HTTP response into a standardized OpenAI embedding response
map_openai_params: map OpenAI embedding parameters to WatsonX-compatible parameters
get_supported_openai_params: list the supported OpenAI parameters for a given WatsonX embedding model
